name: NORMA — Legal Compliance Annotation
description: Legal compliance annotation for BPMN tasks (deontic norms) and exclusive gateways (legal conditions). Part of the NORMA pipeline.

properties.label: Element Type
properties.description: Is this element carrying a deontic norm (task) or evaluating a legal condition (gateway)?

choices.name: 🟦 Task — carries a deontic norm (obligation, prohibition, permission, recommendation or constitutive fact)
🔷 Exclusive Gateway — evaluates a legal fact or triggering condition

properties.label: Deontic Modality
properties.description: The deontic operator of this norm.

properties.label: Norm Statement (Plain Language)
properties.description: Human-readable restatement of the norm for lawyers and auditors. Not parsed by the pipeline.

properties.label: Deontic ID
properties.description: Unique identifier for this norm within the regulation pack. Prefixes: OBL_ · PRH_ · PER_ · REC_ · REC_NOT_ · FCT_

pattern.message: Must match: OBL_xxx · PRH_xxx · PER_xxx · REC_xxx · REC_NOT_xxx · FCT_xxx

properties.label: Agent (Who)
properties.description: The entity that must / must not / may / should perform the action. E.g. AI_Provider, Data_Controller, Manufacturer. Minted as a norma:Agent individual in the knowledge graph.

properties.label: Action (What)
properties.description: Verb phrase describing the action the agent must / must not / may perform. E.g. establish, disclose, deploy, mark.

properties.label: Object (On What)
properties.description: The entity or resource on which the action is performed. E.g. risk_management_system, personal_data, audit_log. Minted as a norma:LegalObject individual in the knowledge graph.

properties.label: Fact Statement
properties.description: The constitutive rule or legal classification in plain language. E.g. 'A system is classified as high-risk if it falls under Annex III.'

properties.label: Binding Force
properties.description: Legal weight of this norm.

properties.label: Condition Statement (Plain Language)
properties.description: The legal question evaluated at this gateway. E.g. 'Does the system generate synthetic content?', 'Is the AI system classified as high-risk?'

properties.label: True Branch Label
properties.description: Label on the outgoing flow when the condition is met. E.g. Yes, High-risk, Consent given.

properties.label: False Branch Label
properties.description: Label on the outgoing flow when the condition is not met. E.g. No, Low-risk, No consent.

properties.label: Triggered Norm IDs
properties.description: Comma-separated deontic IDs of norms triggered by this condition. E.g. OBL_001, PRH_002. Used by the pipeline to generate norma:triggersNorm links.

properties.label: Trigger Condition
properties.description: Free-text description of when this norm applies. E.g. 'when processing biometric data', 'upon deployment of a high-risk AI system'. Human-readable only — not parsed into SWRL rule bodies.

properties.label: Jurisdiction
properties.description: Geographic or legal scope. E.g. EU, US-CA, UK, global.

properties.label: Effective Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
properties.description: Date from which this norm is in force.

properties.label: Deadline / Sunset Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
properties.description: Date after which this norm ceases to apply.

properties.label: Norm Status
properties.description: Current lifecycle status of this norm.

properties.label: Exception / Carve-out
properties.description: Conditions under which this norm does NOT apply. Free text — formal negation is handled at the DDL layer, not by SWRL.

properties.label: Sanction / Consequence of Breach
properties.description: Consequence of non-compliance. E.g. 'Fine up to €30M or 6% of global annual turnover (AI Act Art. 99)'.

properties.label: Risk Level
properties.description: Non-compliance risk associated with this norm.

properties.label: Related Norm IDs
properties.description: Comma-separated deontic IDs of norms related to this one. E.g. OBL_002, FCT_005. Used by the pipeline to generate norma:relatesTo links.

properties.label: Regulation Name
properties.description: Full name of the source regulation. E.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, DSA. Minted as a norma:LegalSource individual shared across all norms of this regulation pack.

properties.label: Article / Section
properties.description: Article or section number within the source document. E.g. 50, 6, 17.

properties.label: Paragraph / Subsection
properties.description: Paragraph or subsection number. E.g. 2, 1(a).

properties.label: Original Legal Text
properties.description: Verbatim quote from the source legislative text. Used for traceability and audit.

properties.label: Regulation URI
properties.description: Dereferenceable URI of the source document. ELI-compatible. E.g. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=OJ:L_202401689

properties.label: Extraction Method
properties.description: How this annotation was produced.

properties.label: Confidence Score (0.0–1.0)
properties.description: Annotator certainty in interpretation. Values below 0.7 trigger mandatory legal review.

pattern.message: Must be a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0

properties.label: Reviewed by Legal Counsel
properties.description: Legal review status of this annotation.

properties.label: Annotator
properties.description: Name or identifier of the person who created this annotation.
